sections.title: Brave Frontier Heroes
sections.content: Her power resembles that of a goddess who controls Gates, but her true identity remains shrouded in mystery. Along with Shida who once saved her life, she continues to support Nogreth as the third general. In Nogreth it is rumored that Good and Evil do not exist, but only pure love. Shida's ideals became her ideals, and soon she was willing to give her life for them. The moment she was pierced by the young knight's blade of justice, she spoke the name of the one she loved.

|member = |gamedebut = |aliases = |counterpart = Imperial Witch Shaiah |bf2 = true }} '''Shaiah''' is a character introduced in Brave Frontier II. She serves as one of the seven Demonlords of Nogreth. ==In-Game Appearance== ==Background== ==History== ===Brave Frontier Heroes=== Her power resembles that of a goddess who controls Gates, but her true identity remains shrouded in mystery. Along with Shida who once saved her life, she continues to support Nogreth as the third general. In Nogreth it is rumored that Good and Evil do not exist, but only pure love. Shida's ideals became her ideals, and soon she was willing to give her life for them. The moment she was pierced by the young knight's blade of justice, she spoke the name of the one she loved. ==Artwork== {{CharacterImage |name = Shaiah |element = Light |image1 = Navi chara bf2 17 0.png |image1note = Neutral |image2 = Navi chara bf2 17 1.png |image2note = Happy |image3 = Navi chara bf2 17 2.png |image3note = Angry |image4 = Navi chara bf2 17 3.png |image4note = Sad |image5 = Navi chara bf2 17 4.png |image5note = Shock |image6 = Navi chara bf2 17 5.png |image6note = Hurt }} ==Trivia==
